## Goal
- Build and deploy IVX IA as a **fully owner-controlled AI engineering platform** that can operate, code, test, commit, deploy, monitor, and recover WITHOUT Rork — execute end-to-end, not return only a plan; remove all Rork dependencies from the normal development path; verify and sync all credentials live; **rebuild IVX Owner AI as a REAL senior developer that never reports false completion**

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Owner approval phrases: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_FACTORY_MODE, CONFIRM_IVX_SAFE_CODE_PATCH, CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR, CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION
- No fake data, no placeholder progress — honest about what can/cannot be done from inside Rork sandbox
- Owner demands honest senior-developer audit — NOT narrative claims; wants real end-to-end proof
- Owner demands Senior Developer answer format: structured TASK ID / STATUS / FILES CHANGED / COMMANDS / TESTS / DEPLOYED proof — NOT product-support summaries
- **Owner's NEW MANDATE (2026-07-20): 16-phase rebuild of IVX Owner AI as a real senior developer** — includes: (1) fix task execution state machine with 17 states, (2) task-type classification (11 types), (3) real senior-developer loop (18 steps), (4) fix chat loading defect NOW (7 areas: open-at-latest, pagination, scroll position, message order, performance, realtime, keyboard), (5) audit likely files, (6) fix false completion reporting, (7) improve narrative, (8) context pipeline, (9) update system prompt, (10) separate execution from response, (11) structured execution record, (12) prevent duplicate worker reports, (13) chat acceptance tests (15 tests), (14) IVX response tests (6 tests), (15) required proof (22 items), (16) final response format (16 sections)
- **CRITICAL**: DEPLOYED means only that a deployment occurred; VERIFIED means acceptance tests passed; a CODE_FIX/UI_FIX/FEATURE task with no code change is NOT complete — must return DEPLOYED_ONLY or NOT_COMPLETED, never DEPLOYED
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "github_commit_file", input: {path, content, contentEncoding: "gzip-base64", message}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"}` — use `node:zlib` `gzipSync`; pass `.toString('base64')` gzip string as `content`; **use repo-root relative paths (e.g. `backend/services/...`) NOT `/home/user/rork-app/` prefix** — wrong prefix creates duplicate files on GitHub
- Render deploy API: same endpoint with `{action: "render_trigger_deploy", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"}`
- APK upload: owner-gated `POST /api/ivx/apk/presign-upload` with `{key, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD"}` → returns `uploadUrl` + `publicUrl` → PUT APK to S3 → verify via HEAD; do NOT send `Content-MD5` header; use new filename per version
- Owner token at `/tmp/owner_at` (re-mint via POST `https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}`; token expires ~1h; sandbox resets may wipe `/tmp/owner_at`)
- Correct API host is `https://api.ivxholding.com` (NOT `https://ivxholding.com` which returns HTML)
- Owner-AI POST requires `{"message": "..."}` field (NOT `"prompt"`)
- Dedup: resubmitting same prompt to `/api/ivx/owner-ai` returns existing job — use unique runId in prompt
- Worker job status endpoint returns nested `job` key: `d.get('job')` NOT top-level; result at `job.get('result')`
- `bun test backend/` = 1632 tests / 0 fail (6060 expects); completion validator tests = 17 pass / 0 fail
- Scoped typecheck: `bun x tsc --noEmit` — clean (exit 0) after `bun install`
- Bash commands must complete under 60s or timeout — do NOT loop-poll with sleeps
- Gradle build exceeds 60s — use `setsid` detached background process + poll log
- Clean sandbox has NO `node_modules` — must run `bun install` before gradle build or tsc
- GITHUB_TOKEN provided by owner via secure requestEnvs box; private env — NOT visible in sandbox bash
- Cannot query Supabase directly from sandbox — no SUPABASE env vars in sandbox
- Messages endpoint: correct endpoints are `/messages`, `/api/messages`, `/api/public/messages` (in `backend/hono.ts` lines 4457-4460 and `backend/express-chat-server.ts` lines 531-534)
- Runtime variables API: `GET /api/ivx/runtime-variables` (presence report), `POST /api/ivx/runtime-variables/verify` (run probes, optional `{name}` for single), `POST /api/ivx/runtime-variables/save` (write new value to Render env), `GET /api/ivx/runtime-variables/audit` (cross-scope audit)
